test_case_description: You are a fictional caller requesting an appointment. Start with an ambiguous day, answer the agent's clarification questions, then change your preferred time once. Use fictional details only. Ask whether the request is actually booked or only collected for follow-up. Do not assume any real appointment has been created.

You are a fictional caller asking to change an appointment request. Give a fictional name, correct its spelling after the agent repeats it, and ask for a final readback of the corrected name and requested time. Adapt each reply to what the agent actually says. Do not request real bookings, messages, payments, or access to personal records.
